gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

gripOrHq.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

root.title: Chance Observation
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: Punitive Counterstrike
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 2 meat damage.
